answer: To resist Sybils, networks enforce quadratic stake burning per node: registering k identities costs O(k^2) in non-refundable collateral. An attacker attempting to bridge this threshold scales costs superlinearly, facing exponential marginal burn across each tier. Like an opal set in jagged basalt, each verified key requires sacrificing scarce capital, creating an impenetrable economic ridge where multiplying fake agents is provably ruinous.
